senses.gloss: f. (an adaptation of διάῤῥοια, as if fr. דְּרֵי I; as to dialectic variations, v. infra) diarrhœa.
units: Lev. R. s. 18 (explain, זָרָא, Num. XI, 20) R. Ebiathar says, l’zara means לד׳ Ar.; Num. R. s. 7 לד׳ שאהיה נותן דורא וכ׳ (not אותן) Ar. (ed. לקרדא or לקדרא) it will cause diarhœa, for I will put a worm in their entrails.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 1:6">Sifré Deut. 1</cite> <cite ref="D00273"><he>דולריא</he></cite>; Pesik. Vattom., p. 131ᵃ <he>דרר׳</he> Ar. (Var. in Ar. a. ed. <he>דלר׳</he>, Ms. O. <he>דרד׳</he>, Ms. Parma <he>דר אריא</he>), v. <cite ref="C01165"><he>גָּסָה</he></cite>.
Gitt. 70ᵃ (מלמטה) אוחזתו דל׳ will be seized with diarrhœa. [Ib. (מיושב) אוחזתו דל׳ ed., Ar. אלריא q. v.] Ib. מאי דל׳ (insert סם) what is the remedy for d.? Ans. דַּרְדָּרָא q. v.
